questions.q: What general term is used to describe living organisms that are too small to be seen clearly with the unaided human eye?

a: Digesting food nutrients in the stomach

a: Keeping food in warm, dark cupboards
Sealing food in breathable cloth bags
Adding high concentrations of sugar or salt

They turn all water into steam
They stop or drastically slow down microbial reproduction and enzyme activity

questions.q: Which of the following is a beneficial application of microorganisms in agriculture?
a: Decomposition of organic manure to enrich soil fertility

questions.q: What name is given to the study of microorganisms?
Which of the following infectious diseases is transmitted primarily through sexual contact?

a: A naked circular DNA strand located in the cytoplasm (no true nucleus)

a: Eating food immediately after it falls on the floor
Washing hands thoroughly with soap before handling and eating food
Storing raw meat next to fresh fruits in an open basket

a: To inhibit the growth of spoilage microorganisms and extend shelf life
